convert_tensor_to_numpy_image: convert a PyTorch tensor into a numpy image array with optional grayscale to RGB expansion
diagnose_network_gradients: diagnose a PyTorch network by calculating and printing the mean of average absolute gradients
save_numpy_image_to_disk: save a numpy image array to disk as a PIL image with optional aspect ratio resizing
print_numpy_array_stats: print the mean, min, max, median, and standard deviation statistics of a numpy array
create_directories: create one or more empty directories if they don't already exist
